own_solution.law: Energy conservation in inverse-square gravity: h = R v^2/(2gR - v^2)
assumptions: no atmosphere, non-rotating moon, inverse-square field (stated)
launch speed below escape speed (2372 m/s)

notes: Verified certified answers: q=60 -> v=1560, h=1.737e6*2,433,600/3,194,280 = 1323.35 km; q=210 -> 1878.54 km; q=330 -> v=1830, h=1.737e6*3,348,900/2,278,980 = 2552.47 km; all below escape speed sqrt(2gR)=2372 m/s. Mass cancellation expression is correct. T9571 and T9D2A are declared numeral-free controls (twins of TAA9D and TFA02), which resolves my pass-1 query about their missing number; they are not claimed as minimal pairs of numbered sentences. TAA9D/T04BD differ only in probe vs relay capsule; TFA02/T9791 share number and unit and differ in time attachment (earlier test vs this firing) plus 'also' and tense, which is the intended attachment change.
